say: Choose a small event you can do very well, like a home birthday for 30 to 60 guests. Treat a family job exactly like a paid one.
Your file has six sections. The brief and venue notes. Your mood board, palette and focal point sketch.
Your quotation with deposit and balance terms, even for family, so you practise pricing. And your run sheet and packing list.
Photos before, during and after. Photograph the empty room first, so the after photo proves the change is your work. Then feedback and a written reflection.
For example, Blessing in Benin City decorates her niece's 10th birthday for 45 guests. She quoted 180,000 naira. Actual costs were 139,000, so a paid job would have made 41,000 profit.

panel.heading: Blessing's planned versus actual
items: Rated 5 out of 5, cake table bare at the side

say: She planned 3 hours of setup. It took 3 hours 35 minutes, because the garland took longer than in practice.

panel.heading: Blessing's planned versus actual
items: Rated 5 out of 5, cake table bare at the side

say: She planned 160 balloons, used 148, and had 9 bursts in the afternoon heat.

panel.heading: Blessing's planned versus actual
items: Rated 5 out of 5, cake table bare at the side

say: She switched to flameless candles when she saw the paper backdrop sat close behind the cake table. Safety comes before the plan.

say: The client rated her 5 out of 5, but said the cake table looked bare from the side. So her reflection names three changes: build garlands the night before, keep 10 percent spare balloons in hot weather, and dress cake tables on all visible sides.

panel.rule: Differences are not failures. They are information.

say: Packages make it easy for clients to choose, and easy for you to quote. These prices are examples only. Build yours from your real costs, then add contingency and profit.
A simple celebration might start from 150,000 naira.

cards.d: Garland on a backdrop stand, cake table, welcome sign. Up to 50 guests. From 150,000 naira.
Backdrop with drape and garland, cake table, up to 8 guest tables, entrance. From 350,000 naira.
Full hall: stage or high table, backdrop, all tables, chair covers, entrance. Quoted after venue check.

say: My decor is beautiful, I am reliable, I am affordable. Every decorator says that.
Specific statements, backed by evidence, build trust faster.
For example, Zainab in Kano got a bare question: how much for birthday decoration? She sent her package catalogue, asked three questions, and quoted with photos of similar setups.
She stated her terms: 60 percent deposit, balance three days before. The client booked the same day.
For example, Ifeoma in Owerri spends days 1 to 30 posting her project photos, setting up WhatsApp Business with two packages, and introducing herself to cake makers and a hall manager.

say: Open a separate account for business money, so you can see real profit. Keep using written quotations and deposits.
Save part of each job's profit in an equipment fund, so growth is paid for by the business, not borrowed. As work grows, consider registering your business name with the CAC.
And protect your energy. Plan rest after big jobs, share lifting with helpers, and carry water and food.

panel.heading: Protect your money and energy
items: Written quotes and deposits, every job
Rest after big jobs; share the lifting

say: To remember. Document one job from brief to pack-down. Compare planned and actual. Build packages from real costs. Show your value with evidence. And set three goals with numbers and dates.
